en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm river or pond with reflections of trees along both banks. On the left bank stands a modest industrial or farm building with a pitched roof and a tall chimney, and behind it a lighter-colored house. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds, giving the rural landscape a tranquil yet slightly moody atmosphere. The image has thin white borders typical of vintage photographic postcards.
